subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Jaguar engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the AJ20 across its X-Type X400 application.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The AJ20 appears exclusively in the X-Type 2.0D (X400 generation, 2003–2009).

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, timing chain components where required, gaskets and seals as standard on every rebuild.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported catastrophic issue pattern has been confirmed for the AJ20 diesel. We don't treat this engine as having one universal failure mode; diagnosis is required to establish whether an engine needs repair, rebuild or replacement.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page — they'll be added once a documented set of completed AJ20 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: JAGUAR AJ20 REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine — illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, timing chain components where required, gaskets and seals as standard on every rebuild.

cards.title: INSPECTION & STRIP-DOWN
cards.body: Careful inspection of the crankshaft, cylinder head, and timing chain components during strip-down.

cards.title: COMPONENT REPLACEMENT
cards.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets, seals, and timing chain components replaced as required.

cards.title: QUALITY CHECKS
cards.body: All major rotating assemblies, oil pump, and cooling system components inspected for long-term reliability.
